top_signals.title: Command and Politics in the War Between Moscow and Kyiv
top_signals.summary:
Our intrepid team covers a lot of ground in this episode: the increasing fluidity of the battlefield, drones and air defense, the biting Black Sea campaign, the causes and aftermath of the firing of Ukraine’s popular defense minister, why Ukraine probably cannot produce PAC-3 air defense missiles (despite what some journalists are telling you), and the likelihood of a new round of Russian mobilization. This episode is Dara Massicot and Michael Kofman at their best.Thanks to NODA AI for supporting this episode. NODA AI is building mission command for autonomous forces. top_signals.title: Trump Cuts Tariffs on Some Ground Beef Imports to Lower Prices
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump signed an order to ease tariffs on some ground beef imports in hopes of lowering prices. But some ranchers and rural state Republicans are pushing back against the idea. Bloomberg Agriculture Reporter Ilena Peng and Howard Capital Management CEO Vance Howard -- who owns a ranch of his own -- discuss how this tariff relief will impact costs, and what it may do to American farm businesses. (Source: Bloomberg)
